layout.arrangement: Title top-center in a light-blue banner; below it the slide is split into a left half with two stacked labeled example panels (Positive Class above Negative Class) and a right half with three stacked panels (Activation Function, Training, Evaluation). A small yellow slide-number circle sits at the top right.

regions.name: title_banner
regions.content: Light blue banner with the slide title; [-1,+1] appears accented/red.

regions.name: positive_class_panel
regions.content: Red Positive Class header, five enemy-aircraft sketches, and a Label column of five +1 values.

regions.name: negative_class_panel
regions.content: Green Negative Class header, five safe-aircraft sketches, and a Label column of five -1 values.

regions.name: activation_function_panel
regions.content: Activation Function title, bi-polor step text, threshold text, and small step plot.

regions.name: training_panel
regions.content: Training flowchart from Input Sample through Model, Predicted Class, LOSS, to Label of Input Sample.

regions.name: evaluation_panel
regions.content: Evaluation flowchart from Test Sample through Model to Predicted Class.

layout.hierarchy: The title banner and color-coded section headers dominate; red Model boxes and yellow Predicted Class boxes are next; airplane sketches and the step plot are supporting illustrations.

visual_elements.description: Light blue rectangular banner with dark blue border containing the title text; the bracket range [-1,+1] appears accented/red.

Positive Class panel: red header “Shoot the Enemy”; tall red-bordered pale-pink box with five black line-art enemy/fighter aircraft sketches; narrow Label column to the right with +1 repeated five times, aligned one per aircraft.

Negative Class panel: green header “Safe”; tall green-bordered pale-green box with five black line-art passenger aircraft sketches; narrow Label column to the right with -1 repeated five times, aligned one per aircraft.

Small bi-polar step plot: y-levels -1 and +1, x threshold at 0; line is flat at -1 left of 0, jumps vertically at 0, then flat at +1 right of 0. Axis tick labels +1 and -1 are shown if legible; no other data values.
visual_elements.position: upper right inside Activation Function panel

visual_elements.description: Training flow: Input Sample -> Model (subcaption: (Any value) -> (-1,+1)) -> Predicted Class -> LOSS -> Label of Input Sample (+1,-1). Arrows point left-to-right.
Evaluation flow: Test Sample -> Model (subcaption: (Any value) -> (-1,+1)) -> Predicted Class (+1,-1). Arrows point left-to-right.
Yellow circle with black outline and black number 3.

imagery: Five simple black outline aircraft in the positive panel, enemy/fighter-style, some with small skull markings
Five simple black outline aircraft in the negative panel, passenger-style with window dots
Small purple step-function line icon in the Activation Function panel
typography_notes: Sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title is bold and larger, centered in the banner. Section headers are bold and color-coded: red for Positive Class/Training/Evaluation, green for Negative Class, blue/purple for Activation Function. Body text is regular black; Model text is white bold on red; LOSS is white bold on orange. Curly quotes are used around “Shoot the Enemy”, “Safe”, and “zero”. No bullet glyphs are used.
animation_state: None; the slide is fully rendered with no mid-build state.
recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to white. 2. Add a top banner rectangle from about 4% to 96% width and 6% to 16% height; fill #DDEBF7, outline #2E75B6, and center the bold title Training Samples with Labels [-1,+1] (Two Classes); make [-1,+1] red if matching the source. 3. Add a yellow circle at the top right with a black outline and black bold 3. 4. In the upper left, add a red bold header Positive Class “Shoot the Enemy”; below it place a tall red-bordered pale-pink rectangle and put five black line-art enemy aircraft sketches in a vertical stack. To the right, add a narrow column headed Label with five +1 entries aligned to the aircraft. 5. In the lower left, repeat with a green bold header Negative Class “Safe”, a green-bordered pale-green rectangle, five passenger aircraft sketches, and a Label column with five -1 entries. 6. In the upper right, add an Activation Function box; inside, left-align the lines Bi-polor step (-1, +1) and Threshold at “zero”, and on the right draw small axes with a purple step line flat at -1 left of 0, vertical at 0, and flat at +1 right of 0. 7. In the middle right, add a Training box; lay out left-to-right: light-orange rounded rectangle Input Sample, black arrow, red rectangle Model in white bold with subcaption (Any value) -> (-1,+1), black arrow, light-yellow rounded rectangle Predicted Class, black arrow, orange rounded/oval LOSS in white bold, black arrow, light-yellow rounded rectangle Label of Input Sample (+1,-1). 8. In the lower right, add an Evaluation box; lay out left-to-right: light-orange rounded rectangle Test Sample, black arrow, red rectangle Model with subcaption (Any value) -> (-1,+1), black arrow, light-yellow rounded rectangle Predicted Class (+1,-1). 9. Keep all arrows horizontal with standard arrowheads, use sans-serif text throughout, and do not add the black bottom bar from the screenshot.
